Data is hosted only as a Dropbox zip: no DOI, no versioning, no checksum -- mirror it and record the retrieval date. Obtain an explicit grant from Leapman/Guay before any external release.

OUR COPY IS THE UNLICENSED ONE (7-for-7 filename match to the cloud.mpi-cbg.de tree). Internal use and training are fine in practice but there is no formal grant. DO NOT REDISTRIBUTE without an explicit release from Muller/Solimena.
